# FG-REVIEW-0027

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`auto-merge`](../../ops/runbooks/auto-merge.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `the_emergency_stop_pauses_auto_merge_and_its_queue_entries` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 自動マージは緊急停止中です。止めた人（プロジェクトの Maintainer、またはインスタンスの管理者）が再開するまで、自動ではマージされません。人がマージすることはできます。
- en: Auto-merge is under an emergency stop. Nothing is merged automatically until the person who may (a project Maintainer, or an instance administrator) resumes it. A person can still merge.
- id: Merge otomatis sedang dihentikan darurat. Tidak ada yang digabung otomatis sampai orang yang berwenang (Maintainer proyek atau administrator instans) melanjutkannya. Seseorang tetap dapat menggabungkan.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C9 (plan 04 M-5 "緊急停止", ADR-0017 Amendment 2026-11-13): a project Maintainer (`POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/auto-merge/stop`) or an instance administrator (`POST /api/v1/admin/auto-merge/stop`) turned the emergency stop on. While it is on, the auto-merge worker queues nothing, the merge queue builds no batch from the project's auto-merge entries (they stay queued, paused) and a batch holding one is thrown away before it lands. A person's entries and merges are not stopped. Logged once when the switch is turned on, and named on every merge request it holds (state `stopped`, class `emergency_stop`).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The toggle is audited (`auto_merge.stopped` / `auto_merge.resumed`, actor the person, resource the project or the instance) and logged `forge.auto_merge.emergency_stop` (warn) with `request_id`, `scope` (`project` / `instance`), `project_id` and `user_id`. `GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/auto-merge` shows `project_stopped` / `instance_stopped` with who and when. Read (read-only): SELECT * FROM forge.auto_merge_instance; SELECT * FROM forge.project_auto_merge WHERE stopped_at IS NOT NULL.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook auto-merge: find why it was stopped (the audit row), fix the cause, then resume (`POST …/auto-merge/resume`; the instance switch by an administrator). Queued auto-merge entries continue from where they were.
